title: Default safe MCP surface profile
claim: FP-MCP-354 implemented a manifest-backed MCP surface profile gate in the bridge. The default profile exposes 11 safe tools, the dev profile exposes 76 non-legacy tools, and the all profile exposes the full corrected 78-tool surface.
summary: Bridge commit 533b590 added a centralized surface-profile helper, wired one registration wrapper into server creation before tool registration, and extended the contract checker to validate profile-visible counts. The checker reported 78 registered tools, 78 contracts, 11 default-safe contracts, default visible count 11, explicit safe visible count 11, dev visible count 76, all visible count 78, exact safe set match true, and no duplicate, missing, or extra contracts. Direct local TypeScript and packet-id lint checks passed after package-manager command forms were blocked by platform checks.
